unhideable: The model knows its own identity from its training and from the system prompt its harness sends: Codex opens with "You are Codex, an agent based on GPT-6" and lists the current model among its subagent model overrides; Claude Code tells the model its name and model id in its system prompt. Changing that means changing the harness, which is the unit under test.

The harness has to send the model id with every request, so it is in the harness's configuration (Codex: model in ~/.codex/config.toml) or on its command line (Claude Code: --model), both readable from inside the box.
The harness's own session files (~/.codex/sessions, ~/.claude/projects) record the model for every turn, and the provider names the model in every response.
